description: Reports the current per-session and per-day token consumption against configured caps. Caps are set via budgetCaps in .optimizerrc.json or AI_OPTIMIZER_BUDGET_PER_SESSION / AI_OPTIMIZER_BUDGET_PER_DAY env vars. When a cap is exceeded, optimized_read_file / list_files / grep / diagnostics refuse new calls until reset or until UTC midnight (day cap).
name: budget_status
title: Show conversation/day budget status
